expected: llms.txt fetchable via curl for LLM tooling
observed: AWS WAF challenge (x-amzn-waf-action: challenge) on plain curl; content-length 0. Machine-readable docs are unreachable for non-browser clients.
impact: Agents cannot self-serve docs; must use skills-hub GitHub repo as authoritative spec.
suggestedFix: Exempt /llms*.txt paths from the WAF challenge or mirror to developers.binance.com.

observed: NVDAB (type=3, 0x02fca66c...) returns stockInfo.price=null during REGULAR session while Ondo/xStocks return a price. Reference price missing for bStock.
impact: premium_bps cannot be computed for bStock from dynamic endpoint; engine must fall back to peer reference or mark UNVERIFIABLE.
workaround: Use another platform's same-ticker reference price, or the kline close, as reference proxy with a source flag.

expected: low-latency read like other public endpoints (~200ms)
observed: 4.4s and 10.6s responses on BSC RWA contracts (vs ~200ms for RWA endpoints).
impact: Route tournament latency dominated by this call; must be parallel/optional.
workaround: Run enrichment concurrently; treat as best-effort.
suggestedFix: Add SLA/caching or document expected latency.

expected: web dev server proxies /api/* to the EquityMux API
observed: API moved to :8001 because :8000 was occupied by an unrelated uvicorn (openquyhoach_api); the running next dev server still proxied to :8000, so every page silently showed stale 404s — pages rendered 'loading…' forever with no visible error.
reproduction: start API on :8001 while another app holds :8000
open /explorer — proxy hits the wrong backend
impact: Silent wrong-backend proxying looks identical to a slow API in the UI.
suggestedFix: IMPLEMENTED: /api/health now returns service=equitymux-api; the dev page warns when the fingerprint mismatches.

observed: mypy 2.3.1 caught a missing 'market' arg — the no-representations branch would have raised TypeError at runtime. Latent crash on an untested path.
impact: Crash instead of a clean NO_VALID_ROUTE receipt when zero representations exist.
workaround: Fixed — arg alignment corrected; mypy gate added to CI.

observed: REPO_ROOT=parents[3] crashes (IndexError) when the package is copied to /app/equitymux — only manifests inside Docker.
impact: Naive Dockerfiles break the app; fixed by preserving repo depth (/repo/services/api).
suggestedFix: Consider making REPO_ROOT env-overridable for shallow layouts.

expected: GET with query params like sibling endpoints
observed: HTTP 400. Actual contract is POST with JSON body {binanceChainId, contractAddress, requestId} where requestId must be UUID v4.
impact: Skill doc understates the request contract.
suggestedFix: Document the POST body + requestId requirement.

expected: swap returns when the swap is done
observed: market-order swap returns success:true + orderId immediately; the order completes asynchronously — terminal state only visible via market-order list polling.
impact: A receipt must never report success at orderId; pipeline polls to terminal state.

expected: peer reference fallback covers the null price gap
observed: peer fallback only helps when a same-ticker peer exists on another platform; bStock-only tickers with stockInfo.price=null still had no reference and failed closed.
reproduction: discover a bStock-only ticker during the null-price window
impact: require_reference_price fails closed despite a trading token.
workaround: Last-resort kline 1d close reference, provenance kline:close (weaker than equity reference — labeled).
suggestedFix: Backfill stockInfo.price consistently for bStock listings.
